## August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 394)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio and Armed Forces broadcasting, three gritty police investigations on Phillips H. Lord's *Gangbusters* (1947–1954), Loretta Young and Rudy Vallee starring in *Mother Was a Freshman* directed by Lloyd Bacon for Anacin (1951), Lee Castle and his swing orchestra remote from Frank Dailey's Terrace Room in Newark (1944), and Alaskan bush pilot adventure on *Night Cap Yarns* (1939–1954):
